name: Kuji Azusa
source:
A third-year student at the academy. A senior who habitually acts and speaks in a rather lewd manner.

She has a free-spirited personality, even pressing her chest against her male friends without hesitation, and is extremely open about sex.

Despite having a boyfriend, she frequently has sex with other men. A habitual cheater.

Her boyfriend is a classmate, a rather indifferent guy. He's a science student, one of the top math students in the country.

[From [url=http://gyutto.com/i/item152444?select_uaflag=1]Gyutto[/url]]
